investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Zephyrgate Telecom (mobile operator); Platform: Microsoft Azure westeurope (zones westeurope-1/westeurope-2/westeurope-3); network range 10.242.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster zephyr-prod-westeu (AKS); Billing: a daily charge job 'subscription-renewals' is triggered by the in-house scheduler 'tick-scheduler', which computes run times from local wall-clock time (Europe/London); charges go through payment-gw to an external card processor; job executions are recorded by job name; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
